glossEn: a sum of money allocated for a particular purpose / a summary of intended expenditures along with proposals for how to meet them
note: a sum of money allocated for a particular purpose / a summary of intended expenditures。线索：the annual budget / on a tight budget。两条边界只差「钱」与「方案」，中文统一译「预算」，合并。

glossZh: 编预算；（vt.）把…编入预算，安排
note: make a budget。动词义。线索：budget for sth / budget $500 / budget two hours。宾语可以是钱、时间、精力。
